Sandbox_WaterPipes_RealisticPurification: When on, taps no longer purify tainted water automatically: tainted water stays tainted until you run it through a purifier tile. Default: off, so taps serve clean water as before.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_GeneratorRefuelThresh: A plumbed generator pulls fuel from the network once its tank drops below this percentage of its capacity. Set to 0 to disable auto-refuelling.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_GeneratorRefuelTarget: When auto-refuelling, the generator is topped up to this percentage of its tank (100 = full).
